<div align="center">

<!-- Every card below is generated by scripts/generate-cards.mjs, run daily by
     .github/workflows/profile.yml and committed into this repo. Nothing here
     depends on a third-party service staying up. All cards are 880 wide so
     their edges line up as one column.

     Order is deliberate and runs most-signal-first: identity and headline
     numbers, then "is this person active right now", then "what do they build
     with", then the slower-moving shape of the year. The tallest and most
     decorative card is last, where its height costs a reader nothing. -->

<picture>
  <source srcset="./assets/overview-dark.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" />
  <img alt="Charlie's GitHub stats and most used languages" width="100%" src="./assets/overview-light.svg" />
</picture>

<picture>
  <source srcset="./assets/streak-dark.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" />
  <img alt="Contribution streak" width="100%" src="./assets/streak-light.svg" />
</picture>

<picture>
  <source srcset="./assets/activity-dark.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" />
  <img alt="Contribution activity as weekly candlesticks" width="100%" src="./assets/activity-light.svg" />
</picture>

<picture>
  <source srcset="./assets/frameworks-dark.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" />
  <img alt="Frameworks and tooling, by repositories using each" width="100%" src="./assets/frameworks-light.svg" />
</picture>

<picture>
  <source srcset="./assets/languages-dark.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" />
  <img alt="Every language, by share of bytes" width="100%" src="./assets/languages-light.svg" />
</picture>

<picture>
  <source srcset="./assets/rhythm-dark.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" />

</picture>

<picture>
  <source srcset="./assets/calendar-dark.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" />

</picture>

</div>
